proof.placeholderBody: These numbers are invented placeholders that shape this page. They are replaced by the real evaluation on held-out test data before submission.
proof.precisionHint: Of the messages we flagged, how many were scams
proof.recallHint: Of the scams, how many we flagged
proof.fprBank: False alarms on genuine bank SMS
proof.fprBankHint: Genuine bank and OTP messages we wrongly flagged
proof.vsTitle: Synthetic test set vs messages written by the team
proof.aiSampleNote: The AI second opinion was measured on a smaller sample of {{n}} messages.
proof.confusionHint: Rows are the true label, columns are what we said.
proof.mDatasetBody: Messages were generated from templates for each scam type, and for genuine bank, delivery and OTP messages, in English, Hindi (including Hinglish), Telugu and Bengali.
proof.mSplitsBody: Messages from the same template family stay in the same split, so the test set never contains near-copies of training messages.
proof.mHandBody: The team wrote messages by hand. They were never used for training or tuning, only for testing.
proof.mSyntheticBody: Synthetic means generated from templates, not collected from real people. Real scams can look different, so real-world accuracy may be lower than shown here.
proof.mLimitsBody: Very short messages, new scam scripts and other languages are harder. A verdict is advice to help you decide, not a guarantee.

tips.title: Tips for you
tips.seen: Seen in {{count}} of your flagged checks

codes.title: Never share an OTP or PIN
codes.body: No bank, police officer or company ever needs your OTP, UPI PIN or password.

receive.title: You never need a PIN to receive money
receive.body: Entering your UPI PIN or scanning a QR only ever sends money. Decline collect requests from strangers.

links.title: Check links before you tap
links.body: Paste a link into the QR & link inspector first, and open your bank only from its official app.

apps.title: Don't install apps a caller asks for
apps.body: Screen-sharing apps and APK files let a stranger control your phone.

pressure.title: Threats and rushing are the trick
pressure.body: Banks and police don't threaten to block you or ask you to stay on the call. Hang up and call the official number.

money.title: Paying to earn is a trap
money.body: A fee to get a job, a prize or high returns means you will lose more. Stop paying.

contact.title: Add a trusted family member
contact.body: Add their number in Settings so Elder mode can call them in one tap.
